name: uniphar.ie
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 109 images have no alt attribute.
lesson: Describe what each image shows in its alt attribute, and use alt="" on purely decorative ones.
summary: www.uniphar.ie scores 60 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 41 are at risk, and 27 pass. Fix first: 20 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 20 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /static/about-us/who-we-are/, /static/about-us/how-we-do-business/, /static/about-us/where-we-ve-come-from/ and 15 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 109 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 4 front-end libraries have known flaws
fix.evidence: swiper 5.2.1 (banner of /staticAssets/scripts/swiper.min.js): 1 known flaw, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2021-23370. Versions of the package swiper before 6.5.1 are susceptible to prototype pollution. jQuery Validation 1.19.1 (banner of…
fix.fix: Upgrade swiper to 6.5.1 or later; upgrade jQuery Validation to 1.20.0 or later; upgrade Moment.js to 2.29.4 or later; upgrade jQuery to 3.5.0 or later. A major upgrade changes behavior, so retest the pages that use it.

fix.title: Security headers on the start page are missing on other pages
fix.evidence: HSTS on 18 pages, frame protection on 17 pages, X-Content-Type-Options on 18 pages, out of 20 pages analyzed. Attackers pick the weakest page.
fix.fix: Set the headers once at the server, CDN, or host config so every response carries them.

fix.title: 19 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /customer/account/login/, /static/about-us/who-we-are/, /static/about-us/how-we-do-business/, /static/about-us/where-we-ve-come-from/ and 15 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: The layout shifts by 0.648 while loading
fix.evidence: Measured once in Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) with no network throttling. A phone on mobile data will be slower. Good is under 0.1.
fix.fix: Reserve space for images, ads, embeds, and late banners.

AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page arrived in 581 ms
